analysis: The supplied changes are CI-only: .github/workflows/ci.yml (head text, lines 1-811) and .github/workflows/integration.yml (patch around lines 304-340). No runtime coordinator, provider, or crypto code is in this batch. The ci.yml diff is not visible, so I reviewed the full head file as context. It adds test steps (release-integrity scripts such as test-app-attest-entitlements.py and test-profile-inventory-auth.py, the threat-model review fixture tests, serving-qualification and receipt tests) and runs the provider and SDK suites. Third-party actions are SHA-pinned. The workflow has top-level least-privilege for the `changes` job (contents: read). No new secrets, `pull_request_target` trigger, or write permissions are visible in ci.yml. The integration.yml patch changes the default-posture smoke lane's expected KV backend from contiguous to paged. It also rejects an inherited DARKBLOOM_CBV2_KV_QUANTIZATION value. This reflects a provider default change that is not in this batch. It does not touch the prefix-cache/SSD policy in T-041 (TTL, HMAC lookup, cacheSalt), and I found no weakening of those controls here. Later passes should check that any provider-side default flip to paged keeps the cacheSalt scoping and the SSD tier's per-donation gates (CBv2PagedSafetyTests, CBv2PrefixCacheHasherTests, which CI still runs) and that the T-041 documentation still matches.
